newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara says to borrow for one-month deposit.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara says to borrow for one-month deposit.

text.p: The Malaysian central bank on Thursday announced it was calling for offers for one-month deposits.
Banks are to submit their offers to Bank Negara by 1100 local time (0300 GMT) through principal dealers.
The central bank regularly intervenes in the market to siphon out excess liquidity or to set interest rates.
Bank Negara last intervened on Oct 18 by taking one-month deposits at 7.05 percent.
